# Berkham Private Travel & Concierge

> Berkham Private Travel & Concierge is a private travel and lifestyle concierge arranging premium hotels, yacht charters, private aviation, ground transportation, villa rentals, restaurant and nightlife access, and exclusive event access for private clients. Registered office: 5 Brayford Square, London E1 0SG, United Kingdom (Berkham Private Travel & Concierge LLP, Companies House OC459481). Berkham acts as an intermediary between clients and a limited circle of trusted third-party providers; some partners are based in Monaco and along the French Riviera.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.berkhamtrvl.com/): services, destinations, event access and the enquiry form.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.berkhamtrvl.com/terms): how a booking works (inquiry, proposal with services, pricing and terms, confirmation after deposit, documentation) and Berkham's role as intermediary.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.berkhamtrvl.com/privacy): how client data is handled.

## Services
- Travel & stay: premium hotel accommodation, yacht charters, private aviation (private jets, helicopter flights, air transfers), ground transportation (luxury car rentals, professional chauffeurs, transfers), exclusive villa rentals.
- Restaurants, clubs & nightlife: access to sought-after restaurants, private clubs and venues.
- Event access: sporting events (F1, Champions League, Premier League, La Liga, tennis, golf, polo, horse racing, rugby, cricket, boxing, UFC, NBA, NFL, Olympics), entertainment (Coachella, Glastonbury, Tomorrowland, Burning Man, Rolling Loud) and red carpet (Fashion Week, film festivals, film premieres, Met Gala, Oscars).
- Lifestyle services: event planning & private celebrations, health, well-being & beauty, gift procurement & personal shopping, floral gestures.

## Destinations
Bodrum, Cannes, Courchevel, Dubai, Ibiza, London, Mallorca, Marbella, Monaco, Mykonos, Paris, Saint-Tropez, St. Barth, St. Moritz, Tulum.
